description: Ministry of Finance - Order under Section 2 and Section 5, Special Commodity Levy  Act, No. 48 of 2007
categorisation: This gazette content imposes and modifies a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders regarding tax rates on specific imported commodities (e.g., sprats, dried fish, butter, salt) and includes provisions for waiving certain levies for pharmaceutical manufacturers. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, the primary content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
